text:
samira: Hey team — need the service overview dashboard for `inference-router` (region: eu-west1). Can't find model-level health panels. Anyone with a link or can grant view perms? Trying to chase some tail-latency spikes.

alex: @samira — here's the grafana link that has per-model panels: https://grafana.internal.redwood.com/d/GTz4f3/inference-service-overview?orgId=1&var-region=eu-west1 : check the 'per-model latency' row. :eyes:

samira: Thanks — clicking now. Seeing p95 ~520ms around 09:12, need to figure out if it's a cold start or a specific model.

emma: For traces use Tempo: https://tempo.internal.redwood.com/search — filter `service=inference-router` and `region=eu-west1`. If you can copy a trace_id I can join. Also we add the trace_id to logs now so linking is easier.

jonathan: Heads up @samira you might not have grafana view permission. We control access via Okta group `infra-grafana-viewers`. To get added, ping #help or drop your email here and I'll add you.

samira: pinging @jonathan — samira@redwood.com

dashbot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy completed for `inference-router-eu-west1` (sha: f3a9c2) at 2026-02-18T08:59 :white_check_mark:

maria: Quick alert note: latency alert for inference-router currently fires on `p95 > 400ms` for 5m. That's noisy in eu-west1 during cold-start churn. Suggest temporarily raising to `600ms` and adding `by(model_name)` to reduce noisy page storms. Also consider a separate alert for tail latency spikes vs steady increases.

alex: If you want a Loki snippet to count 5xx errors in the last 5m, try:
```
{job="inference-router", region="eu-west1"} |= "5xx" | count_over_time(5m)
```

samira: running that now. @jonathan can you confirm when the Okta group add is done?

jonathan: added you to `infra-grafana-viewers`. Should be immediate but try a browser refresh or logout/login if it doesn't show.

samira: I can see the dashboard now, and the per-model panel helps isolate it to model `redwood-mini-v2`. Will dig into traces and post back. Thanks! :thumbsup:

emma: If you want I can open a small PR to ops-runbooks to adjust the eu-west1 threshold and doc the rationale.

samira: yes please — PR would be great, and ping me for review once it's up.

maria: one more FYI — if you tune alerts, include a runbook step to check cache hit rate (`inference.cache.hit_ratio`) so ops doesn't escalate needless routing scaling.

samira: noted. I'll follow up with a short summary in #incidents if we need an oncall page.
